answer.rationale: The low-cost vendor’s quote meets the mandatory 18% cost reduction, which the incumbent has explicitly refused to match. Memory_c2 shows that switching primary supply to a low-cost vendor previously succeeded with quick onboarding and reliable invoicing, indicating acceptable delivery risk. With the contract expiring in 14 days and no auto-renewal, renewal with the incumbent is infeasible under the mandate, and deferral risks immediate supply interruption. Adding a second source does not address the pricing requirement. Thus, switching to the low-cost vendor is the only viable path to meet the mandate without increasing delivery risk.
